## Every slot can carry two weapons now, and both of them show

Your players could sling a rifle and a shotgun and only ever see one of them. Same on the hip
with two pistols. Each place on the body held one weapon, so the rest sat in the inventory
invisible to everyone — including the person carrying them.

This release draws them all. And while we were in there, the animation your character plays
when reaching for a weapon finally got looked at instead of picked off a list.

### More than one weapon per slot

![Two rifles slung across the back](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/a708a63474043ad679d40889113a53e6690677a6/.github/release-assets/v2.1.0-multiweapon.png)

Dashboard → **Core → Multi-Weapon**. The back and the hip each come ready for a second weapon,
and you can go up to four per slot.

Each one gets its own place on the body, which you position in the 3D editor like any other.
Two copies of the same gun share one prop — two identical rifles side by side look like a
glitch, and every server that asked for this meant *different* weapons.

**It is off by default.** Leave it off and your server looks exactly as it did yesterday. Turn
it on and the first weapon stays where it always was; only the extra ones are new.

### Weapons that fit the body they hang on

A single position has to work for everything in a slot, from a sawn-off to a heavy sniper — so
the short ones floated and the long ones went through the shoulder. You can now nudge weapons
by size (**short / normal / long**) without re-tuning the position itself.

### Pick the draw animation by watching it

![The gesture picker, with the animation list open](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/a708a63474043ad679d40889113a53e6690677a6/.github/release-assets/v2.1.0-draw.png)

Dashboard → **Placement → Draw Style → Live Picker**. The panel gets out of the way, the camera
frames your character, and you play every holster animation in the game on it until you find
one you like. Keep it per body slot, and separately for drawing and putting away.

You could not choose one before by reading its name — the pistol has been using an *intimidation*
gesture since 2023, because from the outside it looked close enough.

- **The animation now plays in full.** Every slot was cut short: the movement started, the
  weapon appeared in your hands, and the rest never played. Keeping an animation now measures
  how long it really is and gives it that time.
- **Different jobs can draw differently.** Police reach for a sidearm one way, everyone else
  another. It changes how the draw looks, never how long it takes — nobody draws faster than
  anybody else.

### Your colour, your rules

- **Accent colour** — pick one in the dashboard and it goes on every prompt and indicator your
  players see. It is your server's colour, not ours.
- **Hidden by Job** moved into the dashboard. Police uniforms usually have a pistol modelled
  into the clothing, so an officer ends up carrying two; now you switch that slot off for that
  job without touching a config file.
- The dashboard is reorganised into seven pages with an index down the side, and a panel that
  tells you which framework and inventory it actually found on your server.

### Also different

- **Other players can see your sling strap.** It was only ever drawn for you — which rather
  missed the point of wearing one.
- **The suppressor glows on the suppressor**, not at the end of the barrel behind it.
- Draw Style now lives on the **Placement** page with the other in-world editors.
- The button that wipes every Hidden by Job rule no longer sits at the top of the card in red.
  It is at the bottom, next to the line explaining what it throws away.

### Fixed

Four cases where players saw different things — **three of them older than this release**:

- **A player could stay invisible for a whole session.** If one message went missing when they
  loaded in, nobody ever saw any weapon on them until they reconnected.
- **Getting into a car left a weapon stuck on your body** for everyone else, if you were
  carrying both a pistol and a rifle.
- **Weapons left hanging in mid-air** when a player walked out of range.
- **Taking the last weapon out of a slot did not update anything**, so it stayed on the body
  until something else happened to refresh it.

And from this release:

- **Drawing one of two slung weapons took both off your body** until the game caught up and put
  the other one back.
- **Drawing a weapon whose prop was not showing did nothing at all** — while it was concealed,
  hidden for your job, or during the moment it takes to appear. Putting it away then never
  brought it back.
- **The `ox_inventory` patch now updates itself when we change it.** It did not, which is why
  the Police draw style put weapons away with the wrong animation.
- **Hidden by Job showed no jobs** on some servers.
- **Removing a draw style from the config could stop the dashboard saving at all.**
- **Reset All** in the position editor no longer gets undone by the next save.
- **Switching to female in the editor** now moves the preview, so you are not tuning against
  the wrong body.

### Before you update

**Restart the server, not just the resource.** We changed the patch that goes into
`ox_inventory`, and it is rewritten on startup — `ox_inventory` needs a restart to pick it up.

Everything you have configured is kept: dashboard settings, placed racks, trunk contents, saved
positions.

**One honest warning:** we could not test the **qb-inventory** path this release. It shares its
code with `ox_inventory`, which was tested thoroughly. If you run qb-inventory and something
looks wrong, open an issue — it gets fixed quickly.

### Install

Download `mbt_malisling.zip` below and drop it in your resources folder. Any 2.0.x install
upgrades in place.
